Freezing kits?

3. Can hurt pretty bad. You're basically giving yourself frostbite and hoping it hits the right spot. Works sometimes. Burns like hell every time.

Cutting them off with nail clippers?

Tying it off with hair or dental floss?

2. You're strangling a piece of your own skin and hoping it falls off before it gets infected. It can get swollen and seriously irritated. If it gets infected now you've got a real problem.

Skin tag removal patches?

4. Some people get them to work. Most people end up with a sticky sore spot and the tag's still there. Waste of money for most.
